title: What YOU Taught Me About Hope | Slow English Listening
transcriptText: Let's talk. I've been thinking about hope lately. How powerful hope is. Hope can change the world. Hope is in the music we listen to, the songs we sing together, the meals we eat that warm our hearts, the laughs we share with strangers and loved ones. I think laughter heals our soul. Hope is in the flower that SOMEHOW is growing straight through a crack in the sidewalk. It's in the sun that continues to show up without missing a day. It's in the rain that comes just when you need it the most. It's in the stranger that smiles at you walking down the street. In the poetry that inspires us, the painting that represents us, and the clothing that we express ourselves in. I feel hopeful when I see a flock of birds in the sky or when a butterfly lands in front of me. I feel hopeful when my favorite song comes on just when I need it. when I dance of joy in my room or when I experience something for the first time ever. Whether that's a new skill, a new song, a new person, a new feeling, good or bad. When you feel like all hope is lost, dance, sing, observe, appreciate, learn, express and love. In my experience, hope is the only way. And you guys have given me hope in the darkest of days. Thank you. What is hope to you? What brings you hope? I hope you have the best day today. I hope you find one thing to be grateful for today. I hope the sun comes out today. I hope you eat something delicious today. I hope you love something today. And I hope something loves you today. I hope you are safe today. I know hope is something that feels scarce today. There is so much pain and conflict in the world. But hope is something that nobody can take from us. And I hope you hold on to even the smallest piece of hope today. And to all my viewers around the world, thank you for bringing me hope every day. What do you hope for today? What do you hope for yourself? And what do you hope for someone else? Count how many times I said hope. We've just reached 1 million subscribers and I couldn't be more grateful for all the hope you guys have given me this year and all I want is to try and do the same for you. As some of you know, I have an English community where we learn together, we speak together, and we support each other. It's something really special and I know lots of you would love to be a part of it to improve your English and create more opportunities for yourself. But I also know that for many of you, life isn't easy right now. And sometimes it's just not something you can afford. So, I'm opening 10 free spots in my community for people who are going through difficult for viewers that are going through difficult situations. Wherever you are, there's a link below where you can apply. I'll be reading your answers and selecting a group of people who are truly ready for this. And from that group, 10 people will be chosen randomly. So, please apply for this if you really need it, if you really want it, and be honest with your answers. And even if you don't get selected, everyone who enters their information will be invited to join a private live session with with all of us. Only for those who applied. So no matter what, you're still a part of this. Application closes in 5 days. So leave your answers. The link is in the description. And if you can afford my course, it's only $16 per month with the annual plan. If you're interested, today is the last day to join. But be sure to apply for this only if you truly need it and truly want it. If not, then save room for those who do need it. I trust you guys. And thank you so much for 1 million subscribers. I trust the 10 spots will be given to those who truly need it. So, I hope this brought you hope today. Thank you guys for 1 million subscribers. I hope you learned something new today. And remember, never stop believing. Nothing can beat hope. See you next week.
